integrity: All supporting source files embedded; C++17 exact finite programs recomputed from source. No external validator or expert audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite counts only for binary cyclic words of order 2 through 8; no asserted values beyond this range. Shortest linear superstring lengths and multiplicities are previously tabulated, not novel here. Rooted cyclic counts have not received independent review. Computational verification uses two full finite integer dynamic programs.
title: Exact multiplicities of shortest rooted palindrome-complete binary cycles through order eight
